nodes.title: Hydraulic Pump Fundamentals
nodes.summary: Introduces the fundamental concept of hydraulic pumps and highlights that the terminology may appear in multiple spellings.

nodes.title: Hydraulic Pump: gear, vane, piston
nodes.summary: Covers the three main types of hydraulic pumps—gear, vane, and piston—and explains how pressure requirements influence pump selection.
objectives: Differentiate gear, vane, and piston pumps
Select a hydraulic pump based on system pressure

nodes.title: HYDRAULIC PUMP SAFETY
nodes.summary: Explains safety hazards related to hydraulic pumps, including hot casings and the risk of inlet starvation, and how to mitigate them.
objectives: Identify safety hazards associated with hydraulic pump casings
Explain why hydraulic pump inlets must not be starved

nodes.title: Pressure Relief Valve Role
nodes.summary: Describes the function of pressure relief valves in protecting hydraulic circuits and how their cracking pressure is set below the system maximum.
objectives: Describe the role of a pressure relief valve
Explain how cracking pressure is set relative to the maximum system pressure
Understand how a pressure relief valve protects hydraulic circuits

nodes.title: Relief Valve Testing
nodes.summary: Details the bench testing procedure for pressure relief valves and the use of a hydraulic pump to supply pressure during the test.
objectives: Perform bench testing of a pressure relief valve
Explain how a hydraulic pump is used to test a relief valve

properties.text:
Hydraulic Pump Fundamentals

Introduces the fundamental concept of hydraulic pumps and highlights that the terminology may appear in multiple spellings.

Objectives:
- Define hydraulic pump fundamentals
properties.heading: Hydraulic Pump Fundamentals

properties.text:
Hydraulic Pump: gear, vane, piston

Covers the three main types of hydraulic pumps—gear, vane, and piston—and explains how pressure requirements influence pump selection.

Objectives:
- Differentiate gear, vane, and piston pumps
- Select a hydraulic pump based on system pressure
properties.heading: Hydraulic Pump: gear, vane, piston

properties.text:
HYDRAULIC PUMP SAFETY

Explains safety hazards related to hydraulic pumps, including hot casings and the risk of inlet starvation, and how to mitigate them.

Objectives:
- Identify safety hazards associated with hydraulic pump casings
- Explain why hydraulic pump inlets must not be starved
properties.heading: HYDRAULIC PUMP SAFETY

properties.text:
Pressure Relief Valve Role

Describes the function of pressure relief valves in protecting hydraulic circuits and how their cracking pressure is set below the system maximum.

Objectives:
- Describe the role of a pressure relief valve
- Explain how cracking pressure is set relative to the maximum system pressure
- Understand how a pressure relief valve protects hydraulic circuits
properties.heading: Pressure Relief Valve Role

properties.text:
Relief Valve Testing

Details the bench testing procedure for pressure relief valves and the use of a hydraulic pump to supply pressure during the test.

Objectives:
- Perform bench testing of a pressure relief valve
- Explain how a hydraulic pump is used to test a relief valve
properties.heading: Relief Valve Testing

- Explain how they work together as a system
